explanation: Seafarers from the islands of Southeast Asia crossed the Indian Ocean to settle Madagascar, so Malagasy's nearest relatives are the Barito languages of southern Borneo. Bantu and Arabic loanwords came later.

claims.text: Malagasy's closest relatives are the Barito languages of southern Borneo.
Malagasy is not most closely related to the languages of East Africa, Arabia or southern India.
Madagascar was settled by Austronesian seafarers from island Southeast Asia who crossed the Indian Ocean.
Malagasy contains loanwords from Bantu languages and from Arabic.
